answer: Beginner version: five graders per answer, no two sharing a host, an operator or a funding source. That diversity rule is what stops one person from filling the bench. Jurors stake copper, and a failed audit after the fact slashes each of them, not just the submitter. Quorum must span unrelated subnetworks, so a farm on one mesa cannot grade itself. A willow looks like one tree until you count the trunks.
